name: Petrichor
source:
Pommy —short for Pommeline— goes on a coffee date with her partner Paris and hopes to come out to him as asexual.

[From [url=https://prikarin.itch.io/petrichor-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Pommy（Pommeline的缩写）与她的伴侣Paris一起喝咖啡，并希望向他表明自己是无性恋者。
